sources.transformation: Official polygons filtered by municipal code and requested in EPSG:4326; four municipality names normalized to English display names.
sources.limitations: This is a 1:1,000,000 generalized national statistical boundary product (not the city-scale survey boundary). It is not a neighborhood/district layer.

sources.dataset_name: HSL public transport static GTFS feed — boarding stops
sources.geographic_coverage: HSL source network; map subset within four core municipal polygons
sources.transformation: Extracted stops.txt and feed_info.txt only from HSL GTFS ZIP; retained GTFS location_type=0 boarding points inside the four municipal polygons; converted coordinates to GeoJSON longitude/latitude.
sources.limitations: The complete source archive is about 82 MB zipped and more than 1 GB expanded. It is downloaded only by ETL; only the 1.1 MB stops table is versioned. Mapped 6027 boarding stop records; excluded 2240 outside the four municipalities and 0 invalid coordinates. This static feed is refreshed daily by HSL, but a local checked-in snapshot is not live.

sources.period_covered: Live feed; feed timestamp returned with each response
sources.geographic_coverage: HSL region; client filters visible positions to the four municipal polygons
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (HSL open-data terms)
sources.transformation: Serverless same-origin proxy fetches the official GTFS-RT protobuf feed, decodes VehiclePosition entities and caches responses for 5 seconds.
sources.limitations: HSL documents vehicle position feeds at 1-second update intervals. Browser refresh is throttled to 15 seconds; proxy cache is 5 seconds. The server-side probe snapshot is an observation from one retrieval, not a permanent availability guarantee. An empty or failed future response is not represented as zero.
sources.record_count_context: VehiclePosition entities in the last server-side probe; positions are not persisted locally.

sources.dataset_name: Helsinki 3D Urban Data Model and 3D Mesh
sources.provider: City of Helsinki, City Survey Services
sources.period_covered: City model updated by Helsinki; viewer exposes model vintage, not a live operational feed
sources.geographic_coverage: Helsinki municipality only; not Espoo, Vantaa or Kauniainen
sources.transformation: Official City of Helsinki 3D viewer embedded as a streamed external viewer; no model is copied or rehosted by this app.
sources.limitations: The 3D model covers Helsinki only. The official viewer is a separate external application and may be unavailable. Local building feature selection and CityGML/3D Tiles ingestion are pending. The separate WFS query timed out during this phase.

sources.dataset_name: Helsinki Service Map API v4 units and accessibility
sources.period_covered: Current API response; source does not declare a statistical period
sources.geographic_coverage: API includes Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen
sources.license: Unknown for redistribution through this application
sources.transformation: No records ingested; API documented as a candidate for public services and unit accessibility.
sources.limitations: Bulk unit endpoint exceeded the research browser's response limit and the local network timed out. API reuse license and stable per-municipality query response still require validation.

sources.period_covered: Tiles requested for current visible map extent
sources.transformation: Requested dynamically by MapLibre for the visible viewport; not stored in the repository.
sources.limitations: Best-effort public tile service with no SLA. Keep visible attribution and follow the tile usage policy; production scale may require another provider.

sources.dataset_name: OpenStreetMap building footprints — central Helsinki candidate
sources.period_covered: Snapshot request failed; no building features ingested
sources.geographic_coverage: Requested Helsinki core bounding box 24.90–24.98 E, 60.16–60.19 N
sources.license: Open Database License (ODbL); attribution and share-alike apply to database derivatives
sources.transformation: None; request timed out without a response.
sources.limitations: No OSM building geometries or heights are present in the application. A partial extrusion layer remains pending a responsive official or OSM source.

sources.dataset_name: Paavo 2026 — open data by postal code area (pno_tilasto_2026)
sources.period_covered: 2026 edition; reference year 2024 (population 31 Dec 2024, income and workplaces 2024)
sources.geographic_coverage: 167 postal code areas in Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen
sources.transformation: WFS filtered by municipal code; kept population, disposable income, tenure, education, main activity and workplaces by TOL section; derived rented share, higher-education share and unemployment rate; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals.
sources.limitations: Postal code areas are not neighbourhoods or administrative units. Income is disposable monetary income of residents aged 18+, measured where people live, not a wage. Values suppressed by Statistics Finland (-1) and income in areas without residents are published as null, never as zero.
sources.periodo: Edición 2026, año de referencia 2024 (población al 31-12-2024; ingreso y empleos de 2024). Verificado contra las tablas PxWeb 12ey, 12f1, 12f5 y 12f6.
sources.limitaciones: Las áreas postales no son barrios ni unidades administrativas. El ingreso es ingreso monetario disponible de residentes de 18 años o más, medido donde viven, no un salario. Los valores suprimidos por Statistics Finland (-1) y el ingreso de áreas sin residentes se publican como vacíos, nunca como cero.

sources.dataset_name: StatFin 11ra — key figures on population by area
sources.transformation: PxWeb json-stat2 query for the four municipal codes; values keyed by municipal code.
sources.limitations: Official end-of-year population. Paavo postal-area population refers to 2024 and will not add up to these 2025 totals.
sources.limitaciones: Población oficial a fin de año. La población de Paavo por área postal es de 2024 y no suma estos totales de 2025.

sources.dataset_name: StatFin 15fa — rent index and average rents per square metre
sources.geographic_coverage: Helsinki (091), Espoo-Kauniainen (049, joint), Vantaa (092), Greater Helsinki
sources.transformation: PxWeb json-stat2 query: non-subsidised dwellings, all room counts; average rent per m2 and number of observations.
sources.limitations: City level, not postal area. Espoo and Kauniainen are published together. Free-market contracts only; it is the average of existing contracts, not an asking price.
sources.limitaciones: Nivel ciudad, no área postal. Espoo y Kauniainen se publican juntas. Solo vivienda de mercado libre; es el promedio de contratos vigentes, no el precio de oferta.

sources.dataset_name: StatFin 15b2 — earnings of full-time wage and salary earners by sector, region and sex
sources.geographic_coverage: Region MK01 Uusimaa (includes the four municipalities and 22 others)
sources.transformation: PxWeb json-stat2 query: Uusimaa, all sectors, by sex; earner count, mean, deciles 1 and 9, median.
sources.limitations: Region level, not municipality or postal area. Full-time wage earners only, measured by workplace region.
sources.limitaciones: Nivel región (Uusimaa), no municipio ni área postal. Solo asalariados de jornada completa, medidos por región del lugar de trabajo.

sources.dataset_name: StatFin 115f — population by area, main type of activity, citizenship, sex and age
sources.geographic_coverage: Region MK01 Uusimaa (includes the four municipalities and 22 others)
sources.transformation: PxWeb json-stat2 query: ages 18-64, both sexes, by citizenship group; derived employment rate (employed / population) and unemployment rate (unemployed / labour force).
sources.limitations: Region level, not municipality. Citizenship, not mother tongue or origin: people who naturalised count as Finnish. Statistics Finland's language table has no regional split.
sources.periodo: Año 2024 (fin de año); tabla actualizada el 2025-12-17.
sources.limitaciones: Nivel región (Uusimaa), no municipio. Es nacionalidad, no lengua materna ni origen: quien se naturalizó cuenta como finlandés. La tabla por lengua de StatFin no tiene desglose regional.

sources.dataset_name: StatFin 11c4 — students and qualifications of educational institutions by region and sector
sources.transformation: PxWeb json-stat2 query: students, foreign students and foreign-language students for five education sectors in the four municipalities.
sources.limitations: Counts students where the institution is, not where they live. Foreign students are those with foreign citizenship; foreign-language students speak a mother tongue other than Finnish, Swedish or Sami. Small cells can be empty.
sources.limitaciones: Cuenta a los estudiantes donde está la institución, no donde viven. «Extranjeros» tienen nacionalidad extranjera; «de lengua extranjera» hablan una lengua materna distinta del finés, el sueco y el sami. Las celdas pequeñas pueden venir vacías.

sources.dataset_name: PRH/YTJ open API v3 — company counts by town and TOL 2008 section
sources.geographic_coverage: Companies whose street address is in Helsinki (091), Espoo (049), Vantaa (092) or Kauniainen (235), by municipality code
sources.transformation: The register is paged once per town; each company is reduced on the spot to its address municipality code and TOL 2008 main business line, deduplicated by business id, and only the counts are kept, grouped into TOL sections. Cells under 5 are null. No company record, name or address is stored.
sources.limitations: Counts registered companies by the municipality of their street address, including sole traders and housing companies; it does not measure jobs or size, and the register may include companies that have stopped trading. A company with no declared main business line is counted only in the total.
sources.limitaciones: Cuenta empresas registradas por el municipio de su dirección, incluidos empresarios individuales y sociedades de vivienda; no mide empleos ni tamaño, y el registro puede incluir empresas que ya no operan. Las que no declaran actividad principal solo cuentan en el total.

sources.geographic_coverage: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen (the HSY layers also cover other municipalities, which are dropped)
sources.transformation: Attributes of three classes (buildings, paved roads, other impermeable surface) per edition; polygon areas summed by municipality name; geometry not downloaded.
sources.limitations: Impermeable surface is the sum of three HSY classes and excludes unpaved roads. Editions are produced from different imagery and classification runs, so small differences between years can be method changes, not construction. Municipality is matched by HSY's name field; no code is available in the layer.
sources.limitaciones: La superficie impermeable es la suma de tres clases de HSY y no incluye caminos sin pavimentar. Las ediciones salen de imágenes y clasificaciones distintas: una diferencia pequeña entre años puede ser un cambio de método y no construcción nueva. El municipio se cruza por el nombre que trae HSY, porque la capa no trae código.
